title: Rav Yosef bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Zevachim 3b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.3b.9-10), he raises and resolves a contradiction between changing the designation of an offering and changing the owner for whom it is offered. “Did Rava say …?” is Hyman’s proposed reading, citing Dikdukei Soferim. He mentions him again as explaining a mishnah in Kiddushin 23b. The corresponding passage is in [Kiddushin 63b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.63b.3).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Zevachim text names Rav Yosef bar Ami, then reads “Did Rav say …?” Hyman gives Rava. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2011&lang=en) cites 63b, where Rav Yosef bar Ami explains what a father’s assent means in the mishnah’s betrothal condition.
